chat: Can you describe the nature of your diarrhea, specifically regarding its frequency, consistency, and whether you notice blood or mucus? Also, how long have these symptoms been bothering you, and do you experience any associated weight loss or fever?

I've been dealing with this chronic diarrhea on most days for the past four months, and the stools are loose with occasional mucus but no visible blood. The urgency is intense, and I often feel like I haven't finished evacuating even after going. I haven't experienced any fever or weight loss, just persistent lower abdominal cramping that gets better right after I have a bowel movement.
